concepts.quote: for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) System.out.print("*");
concepts.why: The student kept print as the inner loop body so the stars from one row stay on the same line, and the run confirms the output is correct.
The student placed println inside the outer braces after the inner loop, so it ends each row once its prints are done (several prints, then one println, make one line).
The i++ and j++ were copied from the given code, and the answer shows no reasoning about them.
The task has no separators, and the answer does not deal with the fencepost idiom.
